scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,studio,desktop -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/bridge" "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/studio" "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n bridge,studio -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/bridge" "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/studio"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/protocol && npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/bridge && npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/studio && npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/desktop
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run build:desktop-runtime
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:release && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:release && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac && node scripts/build-mac-pkg.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:release && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:all: npm run build:release && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --win && node scripts/build-mac-pkg.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tapmakerwork/protocol && npm run test -w @tapmakerwork/bridge && npm run test -w @tapmakerwork/studio && npm run test -w @tapmakerwork/desktop
